items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I heard Guy Kelly a couple of times.

ctx.x: A trumpet maybe, I might have paid. You know, I still like trumpet, the way guys blow trumpet. I remember a time back, I remember Punch when he was playing, Kid Rene, Chris Kelly. Nah, I heard Guy Kelly a couple of times. I was like, yeah, yeah, yeah. And, uh, I always liked Rene's style of playing. Loved his style of playing. Down the late days, like I told you, came up with this fella, Kiefer. I went wild about his style of playing.
It's funny, I don't know a thing about him. Bill, did you ever hear good guy? No.
